positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved XML file parser to increase fault tolerance and reduce time for data to become available.
Created multiple MVP web applications to display configuration, error, and aggregate data of Hitachi systems. 
Refactored the code base to facilitate the addition of aggregate data view for new systems.
Transitioned multiple legacy C++ web applications, increasing speed (2-5x), maintainability, and usability.
